name: geogebra-classic-6
description: GeoGebra Classic 6 packaged as a Linux desktop application with Electron

scripts.dist:appimage: npm run build:web && npx electron-builder --linux AppImage
scripts.dist:deb: npm run build:web && npx electron-builder --linux deb

scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:web && npx electron-builder --linux AppImage deb rpm
